github_handle_note: GitHub handle is jordansinger (twitter_username: jsngr). github.com/jsngr exists but has 0 public repos.
philosophy: AI should be a playful design collaborator, not a replacement: describe intent in plain language and get real, editable interface (prompt-to-interface, generative UI) inside the tools designers already use, as shown by his GPT-3 Figma 'Designer' demos, Magician and Diagram (acquired by Figma). He ships small, delightful, opinionated prototypes fast ('I build my ideas'), favoring craft and recreating native UIs in code (SwiftUI samples) to learn by building.
